demo.title: Feedback & Navigation Components
demo.subtitle: Toast, Tabs, Pagination, and Breadcrumbs — each wired for light/dark mode and full RTL support.
demo.toastDesc: Triggers a toast that auto-dismisses after 3 seconds and can be closed manually. Multiple toasts stack vertically.
demo.tabsDesc: Horizontal tabs with an active indicator and an optional badge count.

demo.breadcrumbDesc: Separators between items; the last item is non-interactive and the trail collapses on small screens.
